properties.name: vertical-slice
properties.description: Black Star Square, Osu, Danquah Circle, Ring Road, Labadi. About 16 km2 of land.

properties.name: milestone-2
properties.description: Vertical slice with the west edge moved to -0.220, adding Circle via 2.8 km of Ring Road Central.

properties.name: jamestown
properties.description: Jamestown, Bukom and Ussher Town around the lighthouse and High Street: the first district beyond the vertical slice (circle-reference jamestown-identity-survey.md). About 1.8 km2, sea included.

properties.name: north-37
properties.description: North of the vertical slice along Liberation Road: the Ako Adjei Interchange to 37 Circle, the 37 Military Hospital and the airport approach (the liberation corridor, build_district.py AREAS). Overlaps the vertical slice by 500 m so the corridor's roads join the Ring Road's.

properties.name: east-accra
properties.description: East of 37 to Tema: Liberation Road to the Tetteh Quarshie Interchange, the Legon campus edge, East Legon, J.J. Rawlings Avenue through Madina to Adenta (Adenta Barrier, the SSNIT flats) and the road to Ashaley Botwe, and the Kwame Nkrumah (Tema) Motorway with its exits to Tema Community 1, Harbour Road and the start of the Aflao Road (the legon and tema corridors, build_district.py AREAS). Overlaps north-37 by 650 m so the corridors' roads join Liberation Road's.

properties.name: aburi
properties.description: North of Adenta up the Akuapem ridge: the Aburi Road (the N4) from Adenta Barrier through Oyarifa, Teiman, Ayi Mensah, Kweiman and the Peduase climb to Kitase and Aburi, with Aburi's centre and the Botanical Gardens (the aburi corridor, build_district.py AREAS). Overlaps east-accra by 1.6 km so the corridor's roads join the N4's at Adenta.
